headline: Pinterest introduced Beauty Guides, an AI feature that turns saved hair and nail pictures into a plan with the salon terms, time and price to ask for.
score_reason: Small, practical consumer feature, clearly described; score kept.
importance_line: Pinterest users get plain explanations of what to ask a stylist for, with time and cost estimates, but the estimates have not been tested.
summary: TechCrunch reports that Pinterest on 6 Oct 2026 showed Beauty Guides, built on its Pinterest Intelligence AI, which translates a saved hair or nail Pin into stylist terms such as "balayage" or "almond nails". Tapping "Get the Guide" shows what to ask for, how long it takes, the price range and upkeep, and at launch it covers hairstyle, colour, nail shape and finish.
